answers.label: Feedback on clarified MBM definition
answers.text: As part of energy restructuring passed in 30 states, the definition of Renewable Energy Certificate(RECs) was established in law and state regulation. This system enabled the development of the voluntary market and has worked well to help expand renewable energy and insure proper claims. the MBM should follow these definitions and not create s system in conflict with them.
